caption: The drawing depicts a room corner containing three pieces of wooden furniture in a warm, light brown color with subtle vertical and horizontal paneling details. On the left, there is a door with a dark metal handle, beside which stands a built-in cabinet with a light tan horizontal surface top and a vertical panel front; above the counter are two wooden shelves supported by metal brackets, with paneling and trim behind the shelves. In the corner is a tall, narrow cabinet with a single upper door and a smaller lower door, both featuring simple rectangular panels and small round knobs. To the right, against the adjacent wall, is a rectangular bench or low cabinet with two front doors and similar paneling, also topped with a flat wooden surface. The flooring is dark brown, suggesting polished wood, while the walls are a pale tan or cream color with a wooden rail running along the upper part of the wall in the right section. The ceiling is light and slightly off-white, and the overall composition is orderly, with each piece of furniture placed flush against the wall or in the corner. The drawing has a neutral beige border with a faint hand-written “15 x 20” in pencil in the lower left corner.
title: Built-in Cupboard
